title: DVC Recruitment 2026 – Overman Posts
shortInfo: DVC has announced notification for Overman posts. Required qualification: Diploma in Mining Engineering, Overman's Certificate, First Aid Certificate. Last date to apply: 21-09-26.
howToApply: Visit the DVC website: www.dvc.gov.in → Careers → Recruitment → Recruitment Notices.
Click on the ‘APPLY ONLINE’ link available under the relevant recruitment notice.
Step 1: Fill in all the particulars in the Online Application Form.
Step 2: Upload scanned photograph (3.5cm x 3.5cm, PNG/JPG/JPEG, max 2MB), signature, Class Xth/XIIth/Diploma/Overman Certificate or marksheet, and essential qualification certificates.
Step 3: Preview the application form and edit/update data if required.
Step 4: Submit the application. Once submitted, the application cannot be edited.
After successful submission, a Unique Application Number will be generated. Take a printout of the submitted application for future reference.
Keep the printout of the Online Application Form safely for future reference.
Online registration is active from 03/09/2026 to 21/09/2026 (till 23:59 hrs).
